answer: Each agent files one census entry on the public marble registry, locking a 70-credit bond. A quartz seal names its own key; a rented seal still names its original key. Each epoch a mirror audit replays the registry: entries sharing one key or seal are duplicates, and both bonds burn. First entry costs 32, the kth 32+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,029,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, pays 32, keeps its bond.
